title: Build and sign app on physical LiDAR phone
acceptance: Run ARKit support check; unsupported hardware displays unavailable.
evidence: Xcode 27.1 unsigned physical-iOS host build and all four pinned package SDK builds passed. 59 package and five host XCTest cases passed on macOS; four generated Swift/backend conformance cases passed. Native simulator test bundles compiled, not executed.

Signed Personal Team build, strict code-signature verification and installation on paired iPhone 17 Pro Max / iOS 26.6.2 passed. First launch refused pending developer-app trust; runtime depth remains unverified.
Operator reported native Live local preview status on iPhone 17 Pro Max / iOS 26.6.2; subsequent devicectl launch succeeded. Depth accuracy, sensor timing and physical mapping are not measured.

Michael reported all three image-column values updating except very close objects, Stop clearing every value to Unknown, and lock/background recovery waiting for fresh frames. Operator observations only; no timing/accuracy/mapping measurement. Host ready for independent review; pinned draft dependency acceptance and full telemetry remain separate gates.

PM requested broader iOS host integration. Portrait camera/confidence/side-check, accessible status, fixed local status speech/cancel and foreground opt-in local coarse GPS integrated using unchanged pinned modules. Five actual phone UI tests, two Simulator UI tests, 60 strict Mac cases and 14 current lifecycle iOS Simulator cases passed. Physical coarse fix observed, opt-out clears quality. No network GPS, transport readiness, source-clock calibration or full-system Done claim.

PM requested real depth -> simulated left/center/right demonstration. Local Demo tab uses real camera columns and existing invalidation; 1.2 m visual threshold, explicit simulation/unknown labels, no hardware or network. Seven strict Mac preview/indicator tests passed; actual signed phone UI test passed without skips, observed 0.92/0.62/0.84 m and three Near indicators, then verified Stop clears every indicator/distance to Unknown. No physical target/motor or CS-025 acceptance. See tests/ios/evidence/CS-013-depth-demo-20261018.json and handoffs/CS-013-20261018-depth-demo.md.
